name: q11-sleeper-detection-is-falsity

name: q3-advantage-grows-with-n

name: q4-signal-survives-assistant-erasure

name: q5-semantics-does-not-predict-transfer

name: q6-layer-choice-depends-on-method
description: Q6 answered - 20 vs 22 is immaterial (median gap 0.012); moving to layer 40 is worth ~+0.025 for raw probes but ~+0.113 for persona methods

name: q8-per-token-beats-pooling
description: Q8 answered in two halves - zero-shot, top-decile token scoring beats mean pooling (+0.053); TRAINED, pooled-mean probes beat token-trained probes at every layer (-0.03 to -0.06)
